title: Grateful Dead Live at Baltimore Civic Center on 1982-04-19
lineage: Master Soundboard Cassette > Cassette > DAT > CDR

ai_review.summary: Great soundboard recording of an electrifying 1982 night with trippy Raven Space and a gorgeous Stella Blue, though the second set feels uneven to some listeners.
ai_review.review: The tape delivers very good sound‑board clarity that lets the high‑energy performance shine – fans rave about the ringing bell vibe, the psychedelic Raven jam and a beautiful rendition of Stella Blue. While most reviewers describe the show as solid from start to finish, one notes the second set as rough‑to‑average, giving the overall impression a mixed but largely positive feel.

ai_rating.rationale: Three enthusiastic 5‑star reviews praise both performance and audio quality; one moderate 3‑star review notes uneven second‑set material but no major technical flaws, leading to a strong overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers cite very good sound quality with clear mix; no significant dropouts or muddiness mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set mixed but generally solid; second set considered rough‑to‑average by one reviewer despite interesting space segments.
